stem: In the context of SVT pathophysiology, what is an accessory pathway?

options.text: An extra muscle bundle that bridges the insulating fibrous layer between the atria and ventricles.
A specialized part of the His-Purkinje system that speeds up normal conduction.
A backup pacemaker located in the ventricular myocardium.
A blockage within the AV node that forces electricity through the atria.

explanation: This pathway allows electricity to bypass the normal route, potentially creating a short-circuit loop.
rationale: Think of it as an unintended electrical bridge between two chambers.

optionExplanations.A: This pathway allows electricity to bypass the normal route, potentially creating a short-circuit loop.
optionExplanations.B: The accessory pathway is an abnormal structure outside the standard specialized conduction system.
optionExplanations.C: The pathway is a conduction bridge, not a site of primary impulse generation like a pacemaker.
optionExplanations.D: The pathway provides an additional route; it is not a blockage in the existing normal route.
